scenes.en: Last spring, I helped at a community garden. My job was to check the tools.
scenes.ru: Прошлой весной я помогал в общественном саду. Моя задача была проверять инструменты.
scenes.subject: An adult volunteer in a calm community garden carefully checking a rake, small hand trowel and watering can arranged beside raised vegetable beds. Two other adult volunteers in the background planting seedlings together. Foreground person checks tools rather than planting; distinguish personal task and group work. Soft spring daylight, no signage, labels or text.
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: educational English lesson illustration, one standalone horizontal 3:2 PNG asset.
Style: match the project's existing premium warm 3D editorial illustrations: soft matte materials, tactile knitted fabrics, expressive but adult-proportioned human characters, restrained muted periwinkle blue and warm cream palette, gentle natural daylight, believable detailed objects, quiet uncluttered composition. Clear, appealing, readable at laptop size.
Avoid: any visible text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, watermarks, branding; decorative UI, borders, collage of unrelated concepts; extra limbs, ambiguous objects; cropped heads, hands or important objects. Captions are supplied separately in HTML.
